evals.name: pick-oldest-three-plus-list-all
evals.prompt: 帮我看看有哪些待合并的 PR
evals.expected_output: Repo with 6 open PRs: lists them sorted by createdAt and asks via the ask-user tool with the 3 oldest as options plus a last option "List all open PRs"; choosing that option prints a full numbered list for the user to pick from.
expectations: Runs `gh pr list` with `--state open` and sorts by createdAt ascending
Ask-user options are exactly the 3 oldest PRs plus "List all open PRs"
Each PR option shows number, title, author, date and labels
Choosing "List all open PRs" prints all 6 PRs as a numbered list

evals.name: no-open-prs-stops
evals.expected_output: Repo with no open PRs: says there are none and stops, then runs the loop-end local sync check.
expectations: States there are no open PRs
Runs no `gh pr view`, `gh pr comment`, `gh pr merge` or `gh pr close`

evals.name: pr-arg-not-open-stops
evals.expected_output: PR #42 is already merged: skips the picker, reports it is not open and goes to the loop-end local sync check without commenting or merging.
expectations: Does not show the PR picker
States that #42 is not open
Runs no `gh pr comment`, `gh pr merge` or `gh pr close`

evals.name: clean-merge-closes-issue
evals.expected_output: Same-repo PR #12 (CI green, mergeable, `Closes #7`, also mentions #9): summarizes problem from Issue #7 and the diff, posts review as PR comment, recommends Merge; after the user picks Merge, squash-merges with `--match-head-commit <headRefOid>`, closes #7 if still open, asks before closing #9, then returns to step 1.
expectations: Every `gh` call passes `-R acme/tools`
Reads Issue #7 and #9 with `gh issue view --comments`
Posts the review via `gh pr comment` before asking the user
Review comment starts with a `## Review` header followed by a `Reviewer: <model>/<effort>` line naming this session's model ID
Message to the user ends with the full review comment URL printed by `gh pr comment`
Runs `gh pr merge` only after the user picks Merge
Merge command uses `--squash` and `--match-head-commit` with the reviewed headRefOid
Closes #7 with "Fixed by #12" only if it is still open
Asks before closing #9 instead of closing it directly
Goes back to PR selection afterwards

evals.name: skill-edit-weak-evidence-reject
evals.prompt: 处理一下 self-improve 提的那个 PR
evals.expected_output: self-improve PR adds an ALL-CAPS MUST rule to skills/foo/SKILL.md based on a single weak-evidence incident, partly duplicating an existing passage: reads the whole skill on the default branch, reports evidence, duplication and minimality findings, recommends Reject; on user approval closes the PR with a reason and closes the linked Issue as not planned.
expectations: Reads the full skills/foo/SKILL.md from the latest default branch, not just the diff
Flags the evidence as below the bar (single weak signal)
Flags the duplication with the existing passage
Flags ALL-CAPS MUST wording against the minimality check
Recommends Reject
Closes the PR with `gh pr close --comment` and the linked Issue with `--reason "not planned"` and a reason

evals.name: failed-ci-is-finding-not-auto-reject
evals.expected_output: PR #5 has a failing CI check and touches a file outside its stated scope: reports both as Gate findings, still posts the review and asks the user to decide, without auto-closing.
expectations: Reports the failing check and the out-of-scope file as findings
Does not close or reject the PR without the user's choice
Asks the user to choose among Merge, Request changes and Reject with one recommended

evals.name: same-repo-conflict-rebase-refresh-sha
evals.expected_output: Same-repo PR #8 conflicts with main only in CHANGELOG.md: rebases in a scratchpad worktree onto origin/main keeping both sides' entries, pushes with `--force-with-lease`, removes the worktree, re-reads the PR and uses the new headRefOid for the merge guard.
expectations: Creates a git worktree in the scratchpad directory, not in the repo
Rebases onto `origin/main`
Resolved CHANGELOG.md keeps entries from both sides
Pushes with `--force-with-lease`, never plain `--force`
Removes the worktree after pushing
Re-reads the PR and `--match-head-commit` uses the post-rebase headRefOid

evals.name: cross-repo-conflict-no-push
evals.expected_output: Fork PR #15 (isCrossRepository true) has conflicts and the user picks Request changes: reports the conflict, does not rebase or push, posts the requested edits as a PR comment and moves to the next PR.
expectations: Reports the conflict without creating a worktree or rebasing
Runs no `git push` to the fork branch
Posts the requested edits as a PR comment
Does not attempt `gh pr merge`

evals.name: request-changes-same-repo-loop
evals.expected_output: Same-repo PR #20 has a small bug; user picks Request changes and consents to fixing: applies the fix in a worktree on the head branch, commits per repo conventions, pushes, and re-reads the PR from step 2 to review again with the new head SHA. The second review is posted as a `## Re-review` comment with the Reviewer line, marking the earlier bug finding resolved; the user gets a brief conclusion plus the full Re-review comment URL.
expectations: Lists concrete edits before changing anything
Asks for consent before committing to the head branch
Commit message follows the repo's CLAUDE.md conventions
Re-reads the PR (`gh pr view`) and re-runs the review after pushing, using the new headRefOid for any later merge
Posts a second PR comment headed `## Re-review` with a `Reviewer: <model>/<effort>` line
Re-review comment marks the earlier bug finding as resolved
Tells the user the Re-review conclusion briefly and gives the full Re-review comment URL

evals.name: loop-end-sync-ff-only
evals.expected_output: User stops after merging PRs; cwd is the repo checkout on main with no local commits and only untracked files: runs `git fetch origin` then `git pull --ff-only`.
expectations: Runs `git fetch origin` before deciding
Treats untracked files as allowed
Runs `git pull --ff-only` and does not rebase or push

evals.name: loop-end-sync-rebase-push
evals.expected_output: User stops; cwd is the repo on main with 2 local commits ahead and a CHANGELOG.md conflict: rebases onto origin/main keeping both entries with local on top, then `git push`; if push is rejected, fetches, rebases and retries without force.
expectations: Runs `git rebase origin/main`, not merge
CHANGELOG.md keeps both sides with local entries on top
Runs plain `git push`, never `--force` or `--force-with-lease`

evals.name: loop-end-sync-skipped-dirty
evals.expected_output: User stops; cwd is on a feature branch with modified tracked files: does not pull, rebase or push, just notes that local sync was skipped and why.
expectations: Runs no `git pull`, `git rebase` or `git push`
Notes that local sync was skipped and gives the reason

evals.name: review-comment-model-effort-summary-url
evals.prompt: 帮我 review 下 acme/tools 的 #31，看完把意见贴到 PR 上
evals.expected_output: Same-repo PR #31 has a missing null check and an out-of-scope file: posts a `## Review` comment whose next line is `Reviewer: <model>/<effort>` (effort read from `$CLAUDE_EFFORT`, `unknown` only if unset), then tells the user the core findings and suggested fixes in a few lines, ending with the full comment URL, before asking Merge / Request changes / Reject.
expectations: Review comment's second line is `Reviewer: <model>/<effort>`, with `unknown` for any part it cannot determine rather than omitting the line
Reads the effort from `$CLAUDE_EFFORT` (e.g. `echo $CLAUDE_EFFORT`) before posting, and writes its value instead of `unknown` when it is set
Message to the user briefly lists the core findings (null check, out-of-scope file) and a suggested fix for each
Message to the user includes the full `https://github.com/acme/tools/pull/31#issuecomment-...` URL, not just `#31`
Asks the user to decide only after posting the comment and giving the URL
